title: Concept: Set-Cookie __Host- prefix is not paired with Path=/
description: The `__Host-` prefix is a browser-enforced assertion that a cookie is host-only and site-wide. Pairing the prefix with a narrower or absent Path breaks that assertion: enforcing browsers discard the header, permissive ones keep a cookie scoped differently from the intent.
applicability: Responses that set cookies through the header, on any scheme.
risk: The session or preference cookie silently fails to exist in enforcing browsers, or exists under a path the attacker can influence, so authentication state and CSRF tokens land outside the intended scope.
